description: This file defines the EntryPoint widget for a Flutter e-commerce app, serving as the main navigation hub with a bottom navigation bar switching between different screens like Home, Discover, Bookmark, Cart, and Profile. It manages UI elements such as app bar icons, page transition animations, and icons for navigation.

classes.name: EntryPoint
classes.description: Main widget representing the app's entry point with bottom navigation.

classes.name: _EntryPointState
classes.description: State class managing the navigation logic and UI for EntryPoint.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including AppBar, body with page transition, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: svgIcon
methods.description: Helper method to create SVG icons with theme-aware coloring.
